headline: iFixit teardown finds new MacBook Pro's glowing logo, repair quirks
summary: An iFixit teardown of Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro found the laptop recreates its iconic glowing logo using PROLED technology, while praising easy lid swaps but noting panel removal can crack the device and USB-C repairs require logic board surgery.

claims.statement: An iFixit teardown of the new touchscreen MacBook Pro found it recreates the glowing logo using PROLED technology.

sources.quote: iFixit teardown shows how Apple's glowing PROLED MacBook logo works
The new laptop goes the extra mile to recreate the iconic feature.

claims.statement: The same teardown found easy lid swaps but reported panel removal ends in cracks and USB-C repairs require logic board surgery.
